meaning: A big wild animal with thick fur.
example: Three bears lived in a little house.

meaning: A place with many trees.
example: The house was in the middle of a green wood.

meaning: A hot breakfast made of oats and milk.
example: The bears made porridge for breakfast.

meaning: A round container for food.
example: Each bear had a pot for his porridge.

meaning: Very big.
example: The Great, Huge Bear had a great pot.

meaning: Not smooth.
example: He spoke in a great, rough, gruff voice.

meaning: A low, rough way of speaking.
example: He had a gruff voice.

meaning: Very small.
example: The Little, Small, Wee Bear had a wee voice.

meaning: A soft bag you sit on.
example: The soft cushion was flat.

meaning: A grain used to make porridge.
example: He put oats and milk in a pot.

meaning: The cloud that rises from hot food.
example: Steam went up from the pots.

meaning: A small metal piece that keeps a door closed.
example: She lifted the latch.

meaning: The small hole in a door where a key goes.
example: She looked through the keyhole.

meaning: Wanting to know and see new things.
example: She was a curious girl.

meaning: A tool for eating soup.
example: He picked up the big wooden spoon.

meaning: More hot than you want.
example: That porridge is too hot!

meaning: Perfect, not too much and not too little.
example: That one is just right!

meaning: Not soft.
example: This chair is too hard.

meaning: Not hard; easy to press.
example: This chair is too soft.

meaning: To move from side to side.
example: She began to swing her legs.

meaning: A sharp sound when something breaks.
example: The chair made a sharp noise: crack!

meaning: Steps that go up to another floor.
example: There was a staircase in the corner.

meaning: A soft bag for your head in bed.
example: The pillow was very thick.

meaning: A warm cover for a bed.
example: She pulled the blanket up to her chin.

meaning: Cloth made of many small pieces sewn together.
example: It had a patchwork blanket.

meaning: To open your mouth wide when you are tired.
example: She gave a big yawn.

meaning: Sleeping very deeply.
example: She was fast asleep.

meaning: To make a long sound like old wood.
example: The steps made a creaking sound.

meaning: A person, you do not know who.
example: Somebody has been at my porridge!

meaning: A very high and sharp sound.
example: His voice was high and shrill.

meaning: The flat part at the bottom of a window.
example: She climbed on the sill.

meaning: To close a door with a key.
example: The bear always locked the door.

meaning: To fix something broken.
example: He mended the little chair.

meaning: To hurt someone.
example: They never did any harm to anyone.

meaning: Kind and friendly.
example: They were very good-natured.

meaning: Things used to fix or make something.
example: He took out his box of tools.

meaning: A man who cuts trees.
example: A kind woodcutter found her.

meaning: Something you learn from an experience.
example: She has learned a lesson.

meaning: Drops of water from the eyes when you cry.
example: Big tears came into his eyes.

meaning: The one you like best.
example: Porridge was his favorite breakfast.

meaning: A narrow way through a wood.
example: They set off along the path.

meaning: Many flowers held together.
example: He picked a bunch of wild flowers.

meaning: A home that a bird makes for its eggs.
example: He showed him a bird's nest.
